$comment: REJECTED DRAFT 10 — FICTIONAL. WITNESS FOR: inverse declared, isolated. 03-no-inverse omits the field entirely, which also trips schema shape. This one SUPERSEDES a prior value and declares its inverse as null — the field is present, the shape is valid, and the row is still not invertible, because null means 'there was nothing here before' and something was. Retiring it would delete a value the site was relying on. Without a true inverse the row is not an element of the monoid at all, and mount is undefined on it.
